description: This file defines diagnostics for the Orleans code generator, specifically for cases where [GenerateSerializer] attributes are used in reference assemblies. It includes constants for diagnostic information and a method to create diagnostics based on symbols.

classes.name: ReferenceAssemblyWithGenerateSerializerDiagnostic
classes.description: A static class providing diagnostics related to [GenerateSerializer] usage in reference assemblies for Orleans code generation.

methods.name: CreateDiagnostic
methods.description: Creates a Diagnostic object indicating the misuse of [GenerateSerializer] in a reference assembly, given an ISymbol.
